### 2026-10-18 – 17/18.10.2026.

**3.13h**

17/18.10.2026.
HELLOOOO. So this project is the one and only wardriver's case, which is features through the back and top panel, which are made to look futuristic and which will be printed in black PETG.
I have made a journal because I didn't do a timelapse (duh), and in this time I have made the final finishes on the 3d model, I have edited the Github repo, made the reels and everything else.
